## Vegepygmy Bodyguard (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
 N Small plant (fungus)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 13, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +3 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 55 (5d8+10 plus 5)  
 **Fort** +6, **Ref** +3, **Will** +2  
 **DR** 5/bludgeoning or slashing; **Immune** electricity, plant traits  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** 2 claws +6 (1d3+2) or spear +7 (1d6+3 /x3)  
 **Ranged** spear +7 (1d6+2/x3)  

**Tactics**

 Vegepygmies attack with claws or weapons, usually either a longspear or club. They prefer to ambush opponents, using their coloration to blend with their natural surroundings.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 15, **Dex** 14, **Con** 15, **Int** 10, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 16  
 **Feats** Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness, Weapon Focus (spear)  
 **Skills** Perception +12, Stealth +18 (+26 in forested or swampy areas); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth (+12 in forested or swampy areas)  
 **Gear** spear  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any underground  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, gang (2-5), or patrol (4-7)  
 **Treasure** standard
